name: Glen Coe in a day
description_md:
Glen Coe in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city's main sights. The day is anchored in Glen Coe in GB and covers 11.9 km of walking between stops.

This route features 6 sightseeing stops across the journey. The full day takes about 7.4 hours to complete, which includes visit time at each stop.
